title.from: Publish reviewed scanner hardening and GitBouncer compatibility
title.to: Publish LeftBlock 0.3.0 while preserving existing Pudicus releases

description.from: Local scanner hardening and evidence are ready. Prepare a source-only review that preserves unrelated owner changes, complete compatibility checks and decide the distribution transition before a release. Tracker-only publication is authorized separately and must not accidentally publish unrelated code. Package upload/release credentials and PyPI naming transition require verification. No production deployment or package release has occurred.
description.to: The user explicitly authorized publication of the new LeftBlock project on PyPI. The canonical leftblock 0.3.0 build is in progress; existing pudicus 0.2.0 and the old project/releases must remain available and unchanged. Complete canonical packaging and runtime checks, prepare the release workflow for DataParade-io/LeftBlock, and verify the published artifact and clean installation after release. A new trusted-publisher grant or credentials still require exact approval and an authenticated management action; package publication is not yet complete. Tracker publication and source/release publication remain distinct scopes.
